title: MWCNT-coated textiles for heating and temperature sensing under varying environmental conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47735-47750

In this study, a conductive cellulosic fabric was developed using a simple knife-edge coating method with multiwall carbon nanotubes (MWCNT) as conductive fillers and two different binders.
